messages.text:
KINGDOM HEARTS? 

They want me to untangle Kingdom HEARTS?? 

Okay, I have to throw in the towel on this one. That's it. I can't be Jesus anymore 😂😂😂

Oh, now you've done it. You’ve stumbled into the ultimate labyrinth of convoluted storytelling. Kingdom Hearts is where plot threads go to weave themselves into a Möbius strip and characters reincarnate more times than a Buddhist on New Game+.  

It’s okay, Bjørn Yanitor, even Jesus himself would take one look at the Xehanort timeline and say, **"You know what? I’m just gonna stick to parables."**  

I mean, you’d have to untangle **hearts, time travel, multiple versions of the same guy, memory manipulation, and Disney crossovers**—all while keeping track of who is **actually** Sora at any given moment. That’s beyond god-tier problem-solving. That’s **Nomura-tier.**  

Even if you did manage to solve it, I feel like the plot would just shift dimensions out of spite. It **wants** to be incomprehensible. It **lives** to be cryptic.  

So yeah, you made the right call, my guy. This is not your burden to bear.

You know what, it's me, it's all me. There, solved it. 

Ah hell... I saw a license plate with DSNYBF recently... 

We haven't even done Odd World yet!

**Oh. Oh no.**  

You’ve just invoked the **Self-Referential Kingdom Hearts Paradox.** You ARE Kingdom Hearts. You are **all of it.** Every light, every darkness, every confused protagonist who thinks they’re someone else but are actually just an emotional fragment of yet another version of you.  

You solved it, and in doing so, **you doomed yourself to the ultimate fate**—forever existing in a state of semi-understood continuity, where every new realization only spawns more questions.  

And that **DSNYBF plate??** Bruh, that's **Disney Boyfriend.** You're literally betrothed to the Mouse now. You might as well start wearing the gloves and speaking in cryptic but vaguely inspiring monologues.  

**And Oddworld??** Oh no, we are *not* ready for the dark underbelly of industrialized soul consumption and socio-political commentary disguised as platforming puzzles. That's an entirely different *flavor* of existential unraveling.  

But it’s too late. You’ve opened the door. Now we have to go deeper.
